entries.description: Reviewed the accepted app baseline, the completed stubbed-UAT findings, the current dashboard and /platform/stub artifacts, and the remaining Phase 2 session-set specs through a routed analysis pass to confirm the distributor reframe assumptions before implementation starts.

Created docs/planning/distributor-domain-glossary.md to freeze the canonical AcmeCoffeeDistributors, retail-business, internal-organization, persona, and /platform/stub vocabulary for the rest of Phase 2.

Confirmed that no downstream Phase 2 spec text changes are justified yet, recorded that no new cross-set overlap is safe before distributor-reframe completes, and updated the spec to preserve only the existing narrow intra-set overlap after the glossary freeze.

Created docs/planning/distributor-reframe-migration-map.md to map the legacy AcmeCoffeeOnline story to the distributor baseline while explicitly preserving current technical identifiers that should not be renamed during this review session.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build. Build succeeded with the existing 11 DevEmailInbox XML-comment warnings plus preview-SDK notices, and all 383 tests passed including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web, Playwright, and reusable-library coverage.

Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 1 using the changed planning artifacts, spec excerpt, activity log, and build/test evidence. The verifier returned VERIFIED with no blocking issues.

Reframed the main app shell, dashboard, auth pages, customer-facing surfaces, report titles, and visible admin copy from AcmeCoffeeOnline to the AcmeCoffeeDistributors distributor story while preserving the current technical routes, namespaces, and entity keys.

Updated stub and seed-story content to reflect distributor-to-retail-business workflows, including retail-business-focused stub records, report labels, internal-staff persona display names, role descriptions, and sample order-note narration without forcing the later multi-organization schema changes into this session.
Aligned dashboard navigation labels, retail-business wording, stub reviewer assets, and reusable stub guidance so retained demo and reviewer flows now describe the distributor baseline consistently.

Kept the platform-first baseline intact by preserving existing technical identifiers and route surfaces, then updated the guardrail and Playwright expectations to prove the new distributor-facing copy without expanding into the later multi-organization implementation set.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build. After clearing transient file-lock interference from leftover local processes, the rebuilt solution succeeded cleanly and all 383 tests passed, including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web, Playwright, and reusable-library coverage.
Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 2 using the Session 2 spec excerpt, changed app/seed/doc/test files, and successful build/test evidence.

Updated the remaining active test and planning references that still read like the legacy app story, including retail-business wording in Playwright and observability smoke coverage plus user-functionality notes and the prior notes-driven acceptance baseline pointer.

Created docs/planning/distributor-acceptance-baseline.md to capture the accepted AcmeCoffeeDistributors shell, retail-business terminology, stub-demo alignment, transitional technical identifiers, and downstream guardrails as the durable handoff for later Phase 2 work.

Ran a routed Phase 2 queue rebaseline analysis, then applied the minimal warranted downstream spec updates by referencing the accepted distributor baseline from the roadmap plus the multi-org, app-coverage, E2E, UAT, and docs-readiness specs without rewriting historical artifacts or forcing premature technical renames.

Generated docs/session-sets/distributor-reframe/change-log.md through a routed documentation draft, then finalized it with the accepted distributor closeout summary, downstream handoff guidance, and the actual build/test validation totals.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build. Build succeeded with the existing 11 DevEmailInbox XML-comment warnings plus preview-SDK notices, and all 383 tests passed including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web, Playwright, and reusable-library coverage.

Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 3 using the Session 3 spec excerpt, current activity log, Session 3 diff, and successful build/test evidence. The verifier returned VERIFIED with no critical or major issues; it noted only non-blocking observations about untracked new-file diff visibility and the pre-existing absolute-path style in the roadmap.
